text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! So this summer, you wish to
remake
yourself as racer worthy of
bearing your fans'
expectations, is that
it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was hoping you'd know how I
could do
that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
At times like these, there's only one
answer—you
go FULL BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If all Kitasan Black needed was a boost
to her
energy, that answer would suffice,
but she needs
more than that now...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sure! Thanks for the advice, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Kitasan, let's talk to the other Umamusume tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, that evening, Kitasan Black,
Vodka, and
Gold Ship all head to a little
ramen restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so nobody's expecting anything
from you,
huh... Yeah, getting ignored
and shoved to the
sidelines sucks.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, it was the same in my
village.
Hey, lady! Gimme another
serving of noodles!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair of outliers listen attentively to
Kitasan
Black's woes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've wanted to be helpful and live up to
the hopes
and dreams that folks have
placed on me since I
was little.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's why I'm so unused to feeling
unneeded and
unnecessary. In fact, I
feel like I'm just in
everyone's way...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, that all depends on how you look
at it. Not
having any expectations
placed on you has its
upsides as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing cooler than being able
to stay
under everyone's radar and steal
a race out of
nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Stealing a race out of nowhere... You
really think
that's something worth
doing, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If it were me, I'd be a real sleeper
agent,
waiting for just the right moment
to strike!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And the second I do, I'd shake things
right up
with everything I got! That's
how I live my life.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'd do the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You too, Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yep. In fact, I'd go even bigger and do things nobody expected me to do and really stir up a fuss! That's my way of living!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You don't do anything like that, do you?
Like
strike a pose right out the starting
gate?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I don't, and I don't think I ever will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's "advice" aside, it's certainly
true that
having no expectations on you
opens up the
perfect opportunity to
prove people wrong.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can be like you two,
though. I
mean, it's just...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Amazing. Just when the crowd least
expects it,
you guys thrust yourselves
into the spotlight in a
way they can't
ignore!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, changing the way you live isn't
easy. Heck,
there's no need to do
something so drastic
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you live life by shouldering people's

expectations and doing your best to
meet them
all...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't you try to figure out why
people
aren't expecting anything from
you in the first
place?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I guess that's a good place to start...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yep. If you're not showing up on anyone's radars, then you've gotta figure out how to grab their attention and make them see you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, as they say, the world is yours for
the
taking. But as they also say, what's
yours is mine.
That's just how it is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's certainly one way to look
at it. If
people aren't paying attention to
me, then I have
to find a way to make
them notice me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your advice! Now
I just
need to decide what I'm going to
do next.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you got something out of this
talk. Oh,
by the way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How was I today? Was I the coolest
mentor ever,
or what?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! I'm the cool one here tonight! I
was the
one who brought us to this
ramen shop, after all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You agree, don'tcha, lady? How else
could they
have found this hidden gem?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I can't say you're wrong. You're always
bringing
folks along to this little hole in
the wall of ours.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-how about we just say that you were
both
cool?

text_block_list.name: Vodka and Golshi
text_block_list.text:
No way! Choose which one of us was
cooler!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how we got embroiled in
this strange
popularity contest, but if I
had to say whose
philosophy was more
influential, I'd say...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah, buddy! You get it! Like they
say, great
things come when you least
expect it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Kitasan! Time to smash down the
door
blocking your way! Hup, hup,
hi-yaaah! Nail it
with your knee!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, ma'am! I'll be sure to use a bit of
force
whenever the situation calls for it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's forceful way of living seems
to have
inspired Kitasan Black quite a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But how am I supposed to gain
attention?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Of course it was me! My lifestyle
struck a
chord with you, eh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can tell you all about what it means to
have true
heart!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you! That would be great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's rebellious spirit helps fill
Kitasan Black
with courage.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But how am I supposed to gain
attention?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If nobody's ever expected anything from
me and
their opinions don't change even
after I've given
it my all, what else can I
do?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I think the ramen shop lady can answer
that
better than me.
Well? Whaddaya
think?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Good question. I suppose things are
bound to
work out in the end so long as
you keep trying,
even if no one's paying
you any attention.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
You know, this shop wasn't always this
popular. It
slowly grew busy over time.
Take a look at those
photos on the wall.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're all pictures of
Umamusume! You're
there too, Golshi!
What are they there for?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Those are all Umamusume who've
supported us
over years. Every single
one of them visited us
during their
summer camps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the shop closes, we head to the
beach and
the lady from the ramen shop
shares her story
with us.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
At first, nobody came to our restaurant
at all. But
over time, Umamusume would
occasionally come
in for a bite to eat.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Then, things slowly became more and
more lively.
Of course I was happy with
the change...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
But the more racers who came to eat at
our shop,
the more I saw them cry. And
goodness, so many
of them would cry...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Really. Among the Umamusume who
came to eat,
there were those who
couldn't win any races and
failed to
make a name for themselves...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text: One racer in particular had amazing potential, and she even managed to almost win in a big race... key word there being almost.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I thought that she might just up and quit
one day,
but she still showed up here
every year. It was
such a relief every
time I saw her.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
She slowly gained attention little by
little, and
when she finally won her first
G1 race, my, what a
commotion we
made for her!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume like her have always been
patrons to
our humble little ramen shop.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's amazing... How long did it
take her
to win a G1 race?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text: Well, let's see... About five years.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Five years?!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She once told me that the Twinkle
Series was
like a long journey for her.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
That the only way to reach the finish line
was to
run to the very end. That all she
could do was to
keep believing in
herself and take one step after
another.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget that day... The way all
the other
Umamusume in the room
looked as they slurped
their noodles and
listened to her speak...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, Golshi. You were a
bawling
mess when she finally won that
race...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No, I wasn't! I'm tellin' ya, that was just
'cause
some pepper had gotten into my
ears!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hopeless it seemed, she
kept at it
for five whole years...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even though, deep down, I'm sure she
was super
frustrated with herself.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So many more Umamusume in the same
situation
must've eaten at that ramen
shop...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears glimmer in Kitasan Black's eyes as
she looks
up at the Milky Way, her gaze
tracking its path
across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is quiet as she reflects on
the
feelings of those who walked the
same path
before us. We walk in their
footsteps now, and
someday, her
successor will follow in hers.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm... I'm so pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I knew all along what I needed to do in
order to
grab people's attention! I knew
it all this time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anything near a reputable
enough
track record to my name! I mean,
I've only been
running for one year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But the Umamusume we heard about ran
for five
years before she made it. Five
years! And there
are countless others
like her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yet here I am, complaining...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black directs all her frustration
at herself
and how she let such an
insignificant worry stop
her in her tracks
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's. I'm not going to whine
anymore. I'm
just gonna focus on running
well and winning my
races!
choice_data_list: Let's win their attention from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep showing people that I'm
worthy of
standing upon the sands of
this shore!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I swear upon this ocean and these waves
that I'm
not going to back down! Not
even a single step!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become just as great an
Umamusume
as those who came before
me!
